meta.name: Lawmen Bass Reeves
meta.description: The story of Bass Reeves, the legendary lawman of the wild West, is brought to life. Reeves worked in the post-Reconstruction era as a federal peace officer in the Indian Territory, capturing over 3,000 of the most dangerous criminals without ever being wounded—and is believed to be the inspiration for The Lone Ranger.

videos.title: PART I
videos.overview: Bass rides into hell. Esau makes a violent impression on Bass. Bass escapes his chains, but has to make a hard sacrifice.

videos.title: PART II
videos.overview: Bass and his family endure tough times on their farm. Bass gets a visit from the law and is faced with an interesting proposition.

videos.title: PART III
videos.overview: Bass is sworn in and embarks on his first mission as a U.S. Deputy Marshal. The Underwood gang strikes after Bass is let in on a secret.

videos.title: PART IV
videos.overview: Bass and his new posse man have a fateful encounter at the Women's Boarding House. Jennie reunites with someone from her past.

videos.title: PART V
videos.overview: After pandemonium erupts at Bywater's store, Bass is forced to choose between his oath and family. Sally runs into trouble at the carnival, while Bass confronts an old nemesis.

videos.title: PART VI
videos.overview: Chaos ensues as a firefight breaks out in Checotah. Bass and Jennie have a painful reunion. Bass has an unsettling realization as the myth of Mister Sundown lives on.

videos.title: PART VII
videos.overview: Bass struggles with the weight of the badge like never before. After a deadly mission goes awry, the U.S. Deputy Marshal's fate is left in the hands of someone else.

videos.title: PART VIII
videos.overview: After a waltz with the devil, Bass, Billy Crow, and Sherrill have a dangerous reckoning with Mister Sundown. Meanwhile, trouble ensues for Jennie, Sally, and Esme back at the Reeves' farm.
